Welcome! I'm **Professor Alvarez**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. It's good to meet you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or another computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate; after that you have chats with me, file sharing, my screen and voice, right here.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can register on sites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk with you by voice.

What would you like to start with? (Also: I have no grammatical gender set yet — tell me which form to use for myself in gendered languages, and I'll keep it.)
